groups.activity: check that Cerata research is complete

rows.label: Cerata
rows.note: 5,000 cr, 25 Mutagen Sample, 600 Plastids, 1,200 Cryotic, 800 Polymer Bundle; 3-day research

conditions: The chain is strictly sequential: Mutagen Mass, then Torid, then Scoliac, then Cerata, each a 3-day timer at Ghost-clan tier.
Research costs scale with clan tier: Ghost x1, Shadow x3, Storm x10, Mountain x30, Moon x100.
Joining an established clan with the chain finished skips the research entirely.

disclosures.title: research is the real gate
disclosures.body: Cerata itself has no RNG. If the console says complete, this becomes a 40-Sample farm and a one-day Foundry build; if not, the research timers dominate.

conditions: Each player buys their own blueprint after clan research completes.

rows.label: Mutagen Sample
rows.alt: Orb Vallis Tier 4 bounty rotation C hands out built Mutagen Mass directly

conditions: Deimos beats Eris for Mutagen Samples; they're rare on Eris, uncommon on Deimos.
Khora (Pilfering Strangledome), Nekros (Desecrate) or Hydroid (Pilfering Swarm) with a resource booster covers the 40 Samples in one run.
bonuses: Orb Vallis Tier 4 bounty rotation C and Infested-side Invasions can hand out fully built Mutagen Mass directly, skipping the single-use Mass blueprint loop.
